// diagnostic

E0507

While the loop is reading `{name}`, nothing may change it

What

While the loop is reading `{name}`, nothing may change it

Why

The loop reads `{name}` across its body, so {operation} can change the visited domain, element order, or termination.

Fix

Choose the collection intent explicitly: use a separate result when the original traversal should stay unchanged; snapshot `{name}` and iterate the fixed original set when only the original values belong in the traversal; or use an explicit work queue when newly added values should be visited. Do not use index traversal unless its fixed domain and result meaning are intended.

Worked example

 Fix: Choose the collection intent explicitly: use a separate result when the original traversal should stay unchanged; snapshot `items` and iterate the fixed original set when only the original values belong in the traversal; or use an explicit work queue when newly added values should be visited. Do not use index traversal unless its fixed domain and result meaning are intended.
